comments.comment: Praying for mom and baby!!! Thank you for putting this together girl 💖 I know that you, technology and accounting don’t always get along great (in your defense, legalese is one heck of a language). Rooting for you, for mom, and for baby S! 💖🙏
Thank you for helping this mom and your heart for the unborn. 💕
🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼 to this brave mom, you can do it!!!
Prayers for this brave mother and her precious child! Let her know that she CAN make it work and be successful with her education while being a wonderful and loving mother!
You can do this! Your child is the size of a strawberry and his or her heart is already beating. Rooting for you ❤️
Praying praying!! 🤍 little baby s is so lucky to have such a brave momma!
Thank you for helping this woman. God will smile on you for this. I pray that she is safe and has what she needs.
She is so incredibly brave!! I can’t give financially right now, but I will put her and her baby in my prayers!!❤️❤️❤️❤️

sadly enough, a lot of women after having abortions feel sad and lost and grieve the death of the child they were told was “a clump of cells” and they go down a spiral and end up homeless and hungry. i’m so glad you’re helping her. mothers deserve support ❤️

My prayer now is that you will receive all the strength that God can give you and feel his grace come over you as you walk your new path, with him right by your side. Don’t listen to anyone who tries to convince you otherwise, you’ve made the right decision to keep that little child and protect him. I will be happy to help you move forward. Pray to God, sweetheart include him and everything that you think and everything that you do. I know that he will bless you and is already doing so.♥️🙏🏽✝️
Thank you I have been talking with mama s as well on instagram.... so glad we're working together to save this baby🙏🙏❤️❤️
Thank you for doing this. My prayers will be with you; all struggling mothers who feel pressured into killing their child and those who decide to help them.
